headline: OpenAI's new AI smart speaker to sell for $300-$400, while ChatGPT introduces unlimited text chats for free users
tldr: Today's AI news is dominated by OpenAI's announcements, including a new AI smart speaker and unlimited text chats for ChatGPT free users. Meanwhile, Anthropic is designing its own hardware to power Claude, and Cloudflare has open-sourced its vibe-coding platform. Researchers have also made breakthroughs in forecasting cyclones with AI models. The industry is seeing significant updates, with Azure API Management adding a dedicated AI Gateway tier and NVIDIA releasing new games for GeForce NOW.
